results.note: native_macd_oracle and native_stochrsi_oracle wrap the real talib.MACD/STOCHRSI/RSI with unittest.mock.patch.object(..., wraps=...) and hard-assert call_count == 0 after invoking pandas_ta with talib=False (test_differential.py:41-53, 68-90) — a runtime assertion, not trust in the passed flag.

Sets talib_enabled=True so pandas_ta.macd genuinely delegates to talib.MACD, and asserts the guard's AssertionError actually fires with message 'oracle delegated to TA-Lib' — a real adversarial control proving the guard bites.

CONVERGED_TAIL_LENGTH=32 is sliced from the end of a 500-bar series for both MACD (lines 105-113) and StochRSI (lines 147-157) comparisons, excluding leading/warm-up bars from both oracle and actual arrays.

Read the current registry.yaml directly: only two free-floating comment lines (lines 6-7) were added; no IndicatorDefinition entry for MACD or STOCHRSI exists despite ingest/registry.py already defining talib_function/parameters fields and RECURSIVE_TALIB_FUNCTIONS={'RSI','ATR','EMA','STOCHRSI','MACD'} for exactly this. The 'registry' test is a raw-text substring check (REGISTRY_PATH.read_text()) that never calls load_registry()/IndicatorRegistry.model_validate, so it doesn't prove anything is actually registered or validated. This is the same gap the prior verifier (seq 201, .uf/events.ndjson) already found, and the repo's current HEAD (2b6d0a4) still has it unfixed — a subsequent codex attempt (seq 202-203) exited 1 and produced no new story_verified pass.

stochrsi() returns TA-Lib's fastd but is numerically proven (within 1e-6 on the converged tail) to equal the independent pandas-ta-classic oracle's K column, and the docstring explicitly states 'Return TradingView-style StochRSI K for the newest bar.' — a reader comparing against a TradingView chart's K line is told which column this is, not misled into thinking it's D.
Deterministic gate `uv run pytest tests/test_differential.py -q --no-header -o addopts= --tb=short` exited 0 (6 passed), confirming the file runs standalone.
